projects.title: RepoShield AI
projects.summary: Automated Git repository vulnerability scanner and security analysis tool engineered for CI/CD pipelines. Combines static AST inspection, secret detection, dependency auditing, and AI-assisted remediation reports.
impact: Scans pull requests and full Git histories automatically inside CI/CD pipelines.
Detects hardcoded secrets, insecure dependencies, and OWASP code patterns with AI-guided patches.
Containerized FastAPI + PostgreSQL backend storing audit trails and severity dashboards.

projects.title: PropVal AI
projects.summary: Real estate valuation engine analyzing official circle rates, geospatial boundaries, and property market trends across India to deliver transparent, data-backed price intelligence.
impact: Models circle rates and neighborhood comparables using PostGIS geospatial queries.
Predicts fair market valuations and regional appreciation trends with Python ML pipelines.
Interactive React dashboard for instant property lookup and locality benchmarking.

projects.title: Xerova CRDMS
projects.summary: Criminal records database management system built for strict compliance, featuring granular role-based access control (RBAC), encrypted case dossiers, and immutable audit tracking.
impact: Enforces multi-tier role-based permissions across investigators, clerks, and supervisors.
Logs every record query, update, and export into a tamper-evident PostgreSQL audit trail.
Dockerized Node.js + React architecture designed for secure, reliable institutional deployments.

projects.title: Xerova Cipher
projects.summary: Graph-based investigation tool connecting intelligence records, entities, and transaction logs to surface hidden links, anomalous clusters, and relationship paths.
impact: Correlates entities, accounts, and transaction logs into an interactive multi-hop link graph.
Uses PyTorch + graph analytics to flag suspicious clusters and anomalous patterns.
FastAPI streaming backend paired with a responsive React visual investigation canvas.

projects.title: VIJI PHONICS
projects.summary: Interactive phonics and early literacy learning platform crafted for young students, combining playful HTML5 Canvas activities with crisp Web Audio API pronunciation feedback.
impact: Engages young learners with animated letter-sound blending and interactive canvas tracing.
Delivers real-time audio cues and phonetic pronunciation playback via the Web Audio API.
Lightweight React interface tailored for smooth performance on tablets and school browsers.

projects.title: Parama Lakshmi Traders
projects.summary: B2B inventory management and wholesale billing ERP built specifically for textile distributors to manage stock lots, wholesale pricing tiers, and GST-ready invoicing.
impact: Tracks real-time textile SKUs, bale/lot quantities, and low-stock reorder alerts.
Automates wholesale GST invoice generation, party ledgers, and payment reconciliation.
Full-stack React, Node.js, Express, and PostgreSQL system replacing manual spreadsheets.
